messages:
Ava (Marketing): heads up team, finalizing greenroom + stage tech checklist for next Tue webinar. need quick confirmation on speaker order, demo fallback, and AV handoffs. target format 40m talk + 15m q&a. can everyone confirm availability? :white_check_mark:
Sam (Events Ops): available. i'll schedule dry run Mon 10:00 PT. can speakers upload slides by Mon EOD? :calendar:
Riley (Prod Marketing): speaker slate: Priya (LLM infra), Marco (Cost & perf demo), Lila (customer case). drafting abstracts + 3-slide demo cue cards, will link in a sec: https://drive.redwood/example-decks
Diego (Eng): for demo fallback we should prerecord the demo and have a containerized canned-response route. if live model errors spike, flip to prerecord.
Diego (Eng): ops snippet in case we need to toggle fallback quickly:
`curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/switch -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' -d '{"route":"webinar-model","variant":"prerecord-2026-03-23"}'`
Nico (Video): camera plan: two cameras (speaker + slides), NDI into OBS, presenters join greenroom 15m early. min upload 10mbps. i'll share a presenter checklist (mic, headphones, background).
Ava (Marketing): Sam add prerecorded clip and routing to run-of-show. Riley pin cue cards so Nico can preview camera slides.
Sam (Events Ops): run-of-show draft updated:
- 00:00 join + housekeeping (Ava)
- 02:00 opening + context (Priya)
- 18:00 demo (Marco) — live, fallback clip queued at 20:00 if error
- 30:00 customer case (Lila)
- 38:00 live q&a (panel)
- 53:00 wrap
Sam (Events Ops): reminder: countdown timer + mic checks 5m before go. platform team confirmed token rotation window.
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run-invite -> Mon 10:00 PT to @Sam @Priya @Marco @Lila @Nico @Ava
Riley (Prod Marketing): speakers: upload final slides by Mon 5pm PT. i'll run a content pass after upload.
Diego (Eng): demo KPIs to monitor: target <250ms median latency during replay; autoscale: add 1 GPU if >10% failed reqs over 30s. will add a simple monitor to producer dashboard.
Ava (Marketing): good. Sam can you own post-webinar 30s highlights and social seeds? also capture attendee questions for follow-up.
Sam (Events Ops): yep will produce highlights and seed socials. capturing Qs and creating follow-up list.
Nico (Video): i'll run 10m camera/lights check in dry-run. presenters test background blur and headphones.
Riley (Prod Marketing): draft attendee email + 1-line press hook uploaded to doc, please review.
Ava (Marketing): last ask: 15m mic + demo/network run 30m before start on Wed. who can stay?
Diego (Eng): i'll standby for the switch command.
Nico (Video): i'll stay for AV checks.
Sam (Events Ops): i'll coordinate and post final run-of-show 24h prior. :rocket:
Ava (Marketing): thanks all — i'll post final checklist after Mon dry-run. :party_parrot:
